title: A protocol for the role of TNF-α on regulatory T cell function
protocol: Obtain fresh blood specimens from healthy donors.
Isolate PBMC by Lymphoprep density gradient medium.
Resuspend total PBMC in 40 μl of MACS buffer per 10^7 cells.
Incubate with 10 μl of Biotin-Antibody Cocktail per 10^7 cells for 10 min at 4°C.
Add 30 μl of MACS buffer per 10^7 cells.
Incubate cells with 20 μl of MicroBead Cocktail per 10^7 cells for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash cells with MACS buffer.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml of MACS buffer.
Prepare LS column by rinsing with 3 ml of MACS buffer.
Apply cell suspension onto the column.
Collect unlabeled cells that passed through.
Wash CD4^+ T cells (negative fraction) with MACS buffer.
Resuspend CD4^+ T cells with 100 μl of FACS buffer.
Add 10 μl anti-CD4, anti-CD25, and anti-CD127 respectively.
Mix and incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash cells twice with 3 ml of FACS buffer.
Sort CD4^+CD25^hiCD127^low/-^ as Treg cells.
Sort CD4^+CD25^- T cells as Teff cells.
Treat Treg cells with TNF-α at a concentration of 50 ng/ml or leave them in medium alone as control.
Wash the resulting Treg cells twice with culture medium.
Count the washed Treg cells.
Label Teff cells with CFSE at a concentration of 2 µM, incubating for 8 minutes at 37°C.
Wash the labeled Teff cells three times with culture medium.
Culture CFSE-labeled Teff cells alone or with TNF-α pre-treated Treg cells in 96-well U-bottom plates.
Maintain the culture in the presence of 2×10^3 anti-CD3/CD28 beads for 4 days.
Culture CFSE-labeled Teff cells alone or with non-TNF-α-exposed Treg cells, in the presence or absence of TNF-α, in 96-well U-bottom plates.
Maintain this culture in the presence of 2×10^3 anti-CD3/CD28 beads for 4 days.
Measure proliferation of Teff cells by CFSE dilution using flow cytometry analyses.
